metadata.name: PCI Data Security Standard
metadata.description: The Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) is a global standard that provides baseline technical and operational requirements designed to protect payment card data. It applies to all entities that store, process, or transmit cardholder data.
metadata.classification_reasoning: PCI DSS is a certification framework requiring formal validation through Self-Assessment Questionnaires (SAQ) or on-site assessments by Qualified Security Assessors (QSA), resulting in an Attestation of Compliance (AOC).
metadata.framework_purpose: To protect cardholder data and reduce payment card fraud through implementation of strong security controls across the payment card industry ecosystem.
metadata.framework_scope: All entities involved in payment card processing, including merchants, processors, acquirers, issuers, and service providers that store, process, or transmit cardholder data.
framework_objectives: Build and maintain a secure network and systems
metadata.target_audience: Merchants, Payment Processors, Service Providers, Acquirers, Issuers, QSAs, ISAs, and IT Security Teams handling payment card data
metadata.penalty_for_non_compliance: Non-compliance may result in fines from $5,000 to $100,000 per month, increased transaction fees, liability for fraud losses, and potential loss of ability to process payment cards.
adoption_approach: Conduct initial gap assessment against all requirements
Develop remediation plan and implement controls
Submit SAQ or ROC with AOC to acquiring bank

sections: Requirement 1: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
Requirement 2: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components
Requirement 4: Protect Cardholder Data with Strong Cryptography During Transmission
Requirement 5: Protect All Systems and Networks from Malicious Software
Requirement 6: Develop and Maintain Secure Systems and Software
Requirement 7: Restrict Access to System Components and Cardholder Data by Business Need to Know
Requirement 8: Identify Users and Authenticate Access to System Components
Requirement 9: Restrict Physical Access to Cardholder Data
Requirement 10: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
Requirement 11: Test Security of Systems and Networks Regularly
Requirement 12: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies and Programs

controls.title: Define and Document Security Configuration Standards
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for installing and maintaining network security controls are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures identified in Requirement 1 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Configuration Standards for Network Security Controls
controls.description: Configuration standards for network security controls are defined, implemented, and maintained.
controls.full_text: Configuration standards for NSCs (network security controls) are defined, implemented, and maintained, including standards for all changes made to NSCs.

controls.title: Restrict Services Ports and Protocols
controls.description: Only necessary services, protocols, and ports are allowed through network security controls.
controls.full_text: All services, protocols, and ports allowed are identified, approved, and have a defined business need. Traffic is restricted to only services, protocols, and ports that are documented as necessary.

controls.title: Restrict Inbound Traffic to CDE
controls.description: Inbound traffic to the cardholder data environment is restricted to only what is necessary.
controls.full_text: Inbound traffic to the CDE is restricted to only traffic that is necessary, and all other traffic is specifically denied.

controls.title: NSCs Between Trusted and Untrusted Networks
controls.description: Network security controls are implemented between trusted and untrusted networks.
controls.full_text: NSCs are implemented between trusted and untrusted networks, including the internet, wireless networks, and between the CDE and other networks.

controls.title: Secure Configuration Policies and Procedures
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for applying secure configurations to all system components are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 2 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Configuration Standards for System Components
controls.description: Configuration standards are developed, implemented, and maintained for all system components.
controls.full_text: Configuration standards are developed, implemented, and maintained to cover all system components, address all known security vulnerabilities, and be consistent with industry-accepted system hardening standards.

controls.title: Manage Vendor Default Accounts
controls.description: Vendor default accounts are managed and removed or disabled as applicable.
controls.full_text: Vendor default accounts are managed. If the vendor default account(s) will be used, the default password is changed. If a default account is not used or cannot be disabled, it is removed or disabled.

controls.title: Account Data Protection Policies
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for protecting stored account data are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 3 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Minimize Account Data Storage
controls.description: Account data storage is minimized through data retention and disposal policies.
controls.full_text: Account data storage amount and retention time are limited to what is required for business, legal, or regulatory purposes. Data is securely deleted when no longer needed.

controls.title: Do Not Store Sensitive Authentication Data
controls.description: Sensitive authentication data is not stored after authorization.
controls.full_text: Sensitive authentication data (SAD) is not retained after authorization, even if encrypted. All sensitive authentication data received is rendered unrecoverable upon completion of authorization.
evidence_requirements: Log review showing no SAD storage

controls.title: Render PAN Unreadable
controls.description: PAN is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored using cryptography or truncation.
controls.full_text: PAN is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored by using strong cryptography (with associated key-management), truncation, tokenization, or one-way hashing.

controls.title: Protect Cryptographic Keys
controls.description: Cryptographic keys used to protect stored account data are protected against disclosure and misuse.
controls.full_text: Cryptographic keys used to protect stored account data are protected against disclosure and misuse, including restriction of access to keys, secure key storage, and key management procedures.

controls.title: Transmission Protection Policies
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for protecting cardholder data during transmission are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 4 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Use Strong Cryptography for Transmission
controls.description: Strong cryptography and security protocols are implemented to safeguard cardholder data during transmission over open, public networks.
controls.full_text: Strong cryptography and security protocols are implemented to safeguard PAN during transmission over open, public networks. Only trusted keys and certificates are accepted.

controls.title: Malware Protection Policies
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for protecting systems from malicious software are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 5 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Deploy Anti-Malware Solutions
controls.description: An anti-malware solution is deployed on all systems commonly affected by malware.
controls.full_text: An anti-malware solution(s) is deployed on all system components, except for those system components identified in periodic evaluations that are not commonly affected by malware.

controls.title: Keep Anti-Malware Current
controls.description: The deployed anti-malware solution is kept current with latest updates and signatures.
controls.full_text: The deployed anti-malware solution(s) is kept current via automatic updates, and performs periodic scans and active or real-time scans.

controls.title: Secure Development Policies
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for developing and maintaining secure systems and software are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 6 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Secure Software Development Processes
controls.description: Bespoke and custom software are developed securely following industry best practices.
controls.full_text: Bespoke and custom software are developed securely including software development processes, training for developers, and secure coding techniques.

controls.title: Identify Security Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed through a vulnerability management process.
controls.full_text: Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed. New security vulnerabilities are identified using industry-recognized sources, and risk ranked based on industry best practices.

controls.title: Install Critical Security Patches
controls.description: Critical security patches are installed within one month of release.
controls.full_text: All system components are protected from known vulnerabilities by installing applicable security patches/updates. Critical or high-security patches are installed within one month of release.

controls.title: Access Control Policies
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for restricting access to system components and cardholder data are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 7 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Define Access Based on Job Classification
controls.description: Access to system components and data is limited based on user's job classification and function.
controls.full_text: An access control model is defined and includes granting access based on individual personnel job classification and function, limiting access to least privileges necessary, and default deny for undefined access.

controls.title: Assign Access Based on Need to Know
controls.description: Access is assigned to users based on their job function and need to know.
controls.full_text: Access is assigned to users, including privileged users, based on job classification and function, and the minimum privileges necessary to perform job responsibilities.

controls.title: User Identification Policies
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for identifying users and authenticating access are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 8 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Assign Unique User IDs
controls.description: All users are assigned a unique ID before access is allowed to system components or cardholder data.
controls.full_text: All users are assigned a unique ID before being allowed to access system components or cardholder data. Every individual who has access is uniquely identified.

controls.title: Implement Strong Authentication
controls.description: All user access to system components is authenticated using at least one authentication factor.
controls.full_text: All user access to system components for users and administrators is authenticated using at least one of the following: something you know, something you have, something you are.

controls.title: Strong Password Requirements
controls.description: Passwords/passphrases meet minimum complexity and length requirements.
controls.full_text: If passwords/passphrases are used as an authentication factor, they must be at least 12 characters (or 8 if system doesn't support 12), and contain both numeric and alphabetic characters.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication for CDE Access
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication is implemented for all access into the cardholder data environment.
controls.full_text: MFA is implemented for all access into the CDE. MFA is implemented for all non-console access to the CDE from outside the entity's network.

controls.title: Physical Security Policies
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for restricting physical access to cardholder data are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 9 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Physical Access Controls
controls.description: Appropriate facility entry controls limit and monitor physical access to systems in the CDE.
controls.full_text: Appropriate facility entry controls are in place to limit physical access to systems in the CDE. Access is controlled with badge readers or other devices including key locks.

controls.title: Physically Secure Media
controls.description: All media with cardholder data is physically secured.
controls.full_text: All media with cardholder data is physically secured. Media is stored in a secure location that is restricted to authorized personnel.

controls.title: Logging and Monitoring Policies
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for logging and monitoring all access to system components are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 10 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Enable Audit Logs
controls.description: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components and cardholder data.
controls.full_text: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components and cardholder data, to support the detection, alerting, and analysis of suspicious activity.

controls.title: Log All Access to Cardholder Data
controls.description: Audit logs capture all individual user access to cardholder data.
controls.full_text: Audit logs capture all individual user access to cardholder data. Logs include user identification, date and time, type of access, success or failure indication.

controls.title: Review Logs Daily
controls.description: Audit logs are reviewed at least daily to identify anomalies or suspicious activity.
controls.full_text: Audit logs are reviewed at least once daily. Review includes all security events, logs of all system components that store, process, or transmit CHD and/or SAD.

controls.title: Retain Audit Logs
controls.description: Audit log history is retained for at least 12 months.
controls.full_text: Retain audit log history for at least 12 months, with at least the most recent three months immediately available for analysis.

controls.title: Security Testing Policies
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for regularly testing security of systems and networks are defined and documented.
controls.full_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 11 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title: Perform Internal Vulnerability Scans
controls.description: Internal vulnerability scans are performed at least quarterly.
controls.full_text: Internal vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months. High-risk and critical vulnerabilities are resolved. Rescans are performed to confirm resolution.

controls.title: Perform External Vulnerability Scans
controls.description: External vulnerability scans are performed at least quarterly by an ASV.
controls.full_text: External vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months by a PCI SSC Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV). Scans are performed after significant changes.

controls.title: Perform Penetration Testing
controls.description: External and internal penetration testing is performed at least annually and after significant changes.
controls.full_text: A penetration testing methodology is defined, documented, and implemented. External and internal penetration testing is performed at least annually and after significant infrastructure or application changes.

controls.title: Implement Intrusion Detection
controls.description: Intrusion-detection and/or intrusion-prevention techniques are used to detect and/or prevent intrusions.
controls.full_text: Intrusion-detection and/or intrusion-prevention techniques are used to detect and/or prevent intrusions into the network. All traffic at the perimeter of the CDE and at critical points is monitored.

controls.title: Information Security Policy
controls.description: An overall information security policy is established, published, maintained, and disseminated.
controls.full_text: An overall information security policy is established, published, maintained, and disseminated to all relevant personnel, including vendors and business partners.

controls.title: Perform Risk Assessment
controls.description: A formal risk assessment is performed at least annually and upon significant changes.
controls.full_text: A targeted risk assessment is performed at least annually and upon significant changes to the environment, identifying threats, vulnerabilities, and results in a formal, documented analysis of risk.

controls.title: Security Awareness Program
controls.description: A formal security awareness program is implemented to make all personnel aware of cardholder data security policies.
controls.full_text: A formal security awareness program is implemented to make all personnel aware of the cardholder data security policy and procedures. Personnel are trained upon hire and at least annually.

controls.title: Incident Response Plan
controls.description: An incident response plan exists and is ready to be activated in the event of a suspected or confirmed security incident.
controls.full_text: An incident response plan exists and is ready to be activated. The plan includes roles, responsibilities, communication strategies, and procedures for responding to a suspected or confirmed security incident.
